name: ALÔDev – Product Reorder by Category
author: ALÔDev

sections.description:
Quickly reorder your WooCommerce products by category with a simple drag-and-drop interface.
Help available directly in the plugin. Support: alo@alotrendmarketing.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/alodev-product-reorder-by-category directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products / Reorder Products to reorder your products.
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • Improved drag-and-drop functionality.
  • Updated compatibility for WordPress 6.8.
  • Fixed minor bug in product categorization.

1.0

  • Initial release.
